pages.text: Fires stacks from an adjacent chest at any block you pick with the $(item)Pointer$(), as long as it gets a redstone signal.

1. Place the cannon and put a chest (or hopper) against any of its six faces, with items inside.$(br)2. Hold the $(item)Pointer$(), sneak and right-click the cannon: it is now selected.$(br)3. Right-click any far away block without sneaking: the cannon aims there and the trajectory arc shows while you hold the Pointer.
4. Give the cannon a redstone signal. It fires one stack from the chest every few ticks.
